## Checklist

- [ ] The title is a Conventional Commit, such as `feat: add a date field`.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` and
      `cargo test --workspace --all-features` pass.
- [ ] Tests cover what changed, and the documents it touches are updated.
